contentList.content: Of course you were. And sacrificing our life together in the process.
I can picture the look on my parents' faces already...
Oh?
A new stuffed friend for Karlach, loved beyond repair.
I shall endeavour to be more tactful when trying to make friends in future.
*It has been six months since the Netherbrain fell... six months since you and Wyll last saw Baldur's Gate.*
*You consider Karlach's brain stem - the stalk meant to regulate her body's temperature. Will it come pre-cooked?*
I find a satchel of potpourri worn as an amulet does wonders.
...for now.
Imagine swimming in the Chionthar again, travelling cobblestone roads, setting our heads on down pillows.
Swap Turn to Player 1
It continues apace, though it will take time to topple a powerful queen like Vlaakith.
Then we'll all be able to look out for each other.
Waste. A bloody waste. What will you do now?
I've heard my followers express the same desire. They'll do their best to stop you...
Barbarian
Old friend. So different from when we first met.
I bring justice, not comfort.
Baldur's Gate needs fresh leadership, and I am only too happy to provide. I keep to the shadows, of course, for the sake of my complexion.
You horror! Get ye gone to a dread domain!
Professor Dekarios
It's thanks to what we shared with these old friends that we have a future in the first place. Let's savour the moment.
Wyrmway
My children can make sure of that themselves, I promise you. But we come together in the spirit of friendship tonight, do we not?
Karlach. She was the brightest light that ever burned.
Thine Urge was cured, if thou recallst. Thou need not say such things.
Blood Splatter D
*When the invitation came, you were hip-deep in lemure slime, swarmed by hellwasps, and about to drive the killing blow on a magma claw.*
*You scream, for you cannot speak.*
The feeling's mutual. I've missed you.
Slayer's Improved Extra Attack
I've been pursuing unfinished business. Defeating the Absolute came at the expense of my own concerns - now I have to rectify that.
Well of course you have, darling. It is not easy to replace someone like this.
As you mentioned it just before, what's it like being Mother Superior?
*Some of them accompanied you when you left. Their homes were rubble, and the promise of a sanctuary sheltered from the city was appealing.*
*You faced down the gods, you thwarted the Grand Design - anything seems possible.*
Take Karlach's place.
I'm afraid time works quite differently in Elysium. I didn't realise how long I'd been gone, until I received Withers' summons.
I should speak to the others. Excuse me.
Well, I had to check you were worthy of Gale's guardianship somehow. You passed, though by the breadth of a tressym's feather.
It's good to see you too, Minsc.
We mean to slay every last sarth and kith'rak. Perhaps the Challenger of Gods would care to join us.
You have a good heart and a sharp mind, Wyll. Trust your own instincts, and the city will be lucky to have you.
Tombstone
And with Cazador still out there, I could hardly show my face. So I retreated to the sewers to hide, bide my time, and enjoy all the rats one can eat.
I wish we didn't have to go back.
Charming. I see godhood's worked wonders on your manners...
Of course, I'd be happy to kill him.
It has taken all of Orpheus' efforts to conjure my projection - and all of mine to convince him to let me come.
Only faintly, I'm afraid. I miss the sweet scents of the Sword Coast. And I miss you.
*You dream of them often, and now you will see if your dreams have become their reality.*
How about a hug from an illithid?
Kiss him.
As Minsc hunts the fiends inside the city walls, so does Wyll hunt the devils outside them! Let us meet in the middle for a hearty toast before long - Boo's treat!
Soon we shall be together, and I will not want to let you go again.
Everyone in these Realms is afraid of something. Wolves, sunlight, beasts, fiends, death... loneliness.
Sketch Bubble B
No, please carry on playing.
Halsin's commune is lovely, especially this time of year.
I'd see those who'd tormented me in the past receive the same.
Step out of line and I'll have no choice but to get in your way.
I don't suppose you ever miss Mizora?
Truly you remain a mistress of torment.
You could capitalise on history repeating itself. How about: 'The Bhaalspawn 2'?

Hero of Baldur's Gate, Vanquisher of the Absolute!

The city is forever in your debt. For without your valour, your audacity, your sacrifice, it would not know renewal.

It is not temples and inns and homes that I speak of, but hearts. Baldur's Gate can never be the city it was before it suffered the Absolute's touch. And that is as it should be. The survivors have borne witness to their home's near-destruction. They have come to regret turning a blind eye to the cruelty Gortash disguised as 'safety' and 'security'. And they understand - just as I have come to understand - that trust, compassion, and unity are the foundation of Baldur's Gate.

Our gates are open once more to the disowned and displaced. The Flaming Fist will learn to be true servants of the people. And I? I will devote myself to ridding the Gate of the shameful fears that allowed evil to enter our homes and sit at our tables.

Yours,
Ulder Ravengard
I - hold on a moment. *Sniff.* Do you smell that?
Oh, before I forget - I've made contact with an assassin, name of Artemis, a killer of killers. Certain arrangements can be made.
Snowflake C
Stolen Content
My dear child, I already know all there is to know.
Recount some of your recent exploits, sparing no detail.
Stand down - I protect the Prism on our queen's behalf!
Yours is a heart I would never let break. But it is not time yet.
Step on them, and his power will be ours.
Original
I've been pursuing unfinished business. Defeating the Absolute came at the expense of my own concerns - now I have to rectify that.
Drink up, Adventurer!
Jealous, are you?
A pair of fried frog legs, eh?
It's the one thing I wanted. To have you by my side when my time came. And you weren't there. Luckily, I have truly excellent friends.
Ah! What was that?
That ranger's left a mountain of corpses in his wake and collected a tale or two. You'd indulge him one, yes?
This must be the work of the Absolute.
We're of a like mind then. Perhaps we should see about adventuring together at some point - for old time's sake.
My ambitions require no god to aid them. I need no more than my own wiles to slay Vlaakith's assassins.

Well, perhaps easy isn't quite the right word - we'll have to retrace our steps back out of the Shadow Curse. I'd like to get to know you better without worrying about hazardous surroundings, if it's all the same.
*A most perfect weapon - so particularly placed. To snatch it risks ruin. But to leave it? A waste.*
Pet your old friend.
The power to raise or ruin empires lies with you now. But how shall you wield it?
Heart A
I'm glad you could slip away to see your father. He must be so proud of you.
Avernus has proven, ahem, lively - but at least I have Karlach by my side. Her laugh parts the clouds.
You can't miss it! So... shiny.
Pose B
Unfriend User
While your body resides in the cold expanses of the Astral Sea, you have projected a likeness of yourself here for the evening.
That it is.
Baldur's Mouth Will Not Be Silenced! Paper Maintains Integrity Despite Political Pressure
Well you understand the gravity of the role, which means you're the right person for it.
Dusky Ensemble
*A familiar, cautious pang pierces the periphery of your mind and soul.*
We are nearing the end of our journey. Whatever business we had regarding Duke Ravengard will go unfinished.
You, on the other hand, are perfectly suited to facing him! And killing him, one hopes.
I'm sorry. I promise, your sacrifice hasn't gone forgotten. It's afforded me a life of my own making: slaying the beasts of the Coast.
Letter from Barcus

On the road to Baldur's Gate, Astarion revealed his true nature to us - he's a vampire spawn! He assured us he won't drink our blood and explained that he was turned by a powerful vampire named Cazador Szarr, who still lives in Baldur's Gate.
You're a sentimental creature at heart, you know that?
I've been researching the tale of the first Blackstaff, Khelben Arunsun. My abridged notes would make for a fascinating bedtime story.
Then it would fit well with that ludicrous hairstyle you're so fond of.
Hardwood Casket
My people are the ones I chose. They are here, on Faerûn.
I may have little love for this city, but so long as my family chooses to serve it - I can do no less.
Lolth's followers are pitiless. You threaded the needle by surviving.
Pspspspsps.
Thou faced thy fate bravely. Yet thou chose death over life. Dost thou regret it?
I thought perhaps you mightn't want to be reminded of the past, even if it was to see old friends. But I'm glad to be proven wrong.
Kiss her.
I have never needed anyone. But I want you.
I'm sorry I haven't reached out. I guess I wasn't sure what you'd make of me. I've changed so much. But then again, you have too.
Not so much changed as reverted. Back to skulking in the dark.
The last time I saw you, you were running from the sun. What happened?
Perhaps you'd be willing to come meet Gale's mother, some time? She misses him so - and I know it would do her heart a world of good to discuss her son with someone who knew him as he was.
The key is to ensure your followers rely on you, but cannot rely on one another. That way, they cannot unite against you.
Not a what, but a who. The immortal god-king of the githzerai - an exiled people, once kin with mine until the madness of civil war ripped our one sky into two.
Oh come here and pay the tax, silly.
It's good to see you again, Gale. I've missed you.
Honestly, I just needed someone strong enough to carry around all my gear.
It is a special occasion after all. Just haul me away should you find me bare-chested and singing the songs of my ancestors.
A great Warrior of the Comet walks among us! Looking as stunning as ever - if a bit less corporeal than I expected.
You don't have to be here if you don't want to, Gale...
Don't fret, Gale. You look wonderful.
I feel satisfied. I accomplished everything I wanted to do.
*Now, you must leave them for a brief while, and return to the surface, for you have received an invitation to celebrate upon familiar grounds.*
Is that supposed to be funny? I've been crouched in sewers, sucking on vermin!
Stifle your excitement. This is grotesque.
Well of course not, darling! We've all seen what you can do against a giant, floating brain - a vampire will be a walk in the graveyard after that.
We thought we'd found sanctuary here, but the druids have determined to turn us out.
I was afforded a destiny of my own choosing. When he comes of age, it is only right I give Xan the same.
Orin's Dagger
But not to worry, I'm sure our paths will cross again.
Is that any way to speak to the god of ambition?
The Zhentarim rule the city's underbelly - so Minsc and Boo went to give them a tickle. There were harsh words. Battle-cries. Some manner of... head-wound?
Ah, a most welcome sight.
Black Market Black Magic: Devil's Fee Goods Still Unaccounted For
*As it is, you'll gather in a familiar place, and one altogether more suitable for such joyful reflection.*
Excited
The Blade of Frontiers, famed for protecting the weak and slaying monsters. I hope you don't think either will be necessary tonight.
I'd forgotten what it felt like, to greet a sunrise without fear of it being my last.
The third charge it made, I struck the rock with Scorching Ray. The ground split apart the moment the beast stomped onto it.
*Not long now. Not long. Wait until they are at rest to strike. Patience.*
A rather fetching one actually. It's called the Underdark - you might know it.
I'm sure some of them like you.
Divinity would have been nice, it's true...
Ahem, if we journey together, it would be as equals. I think we've both been through enough to have earned each other's respect by now.
I've told my students plenty of tales about our escapades. You're something of a hero to them, you know.
Regale Halsin with tales of your tranquil life with your family and coterie of animals.
He's the god he deserves to be.
Metallic Boots
A pity, you could have at least had the conviction of your choice. Now you simply look weak.
Well, these arms are not just for show. And it was an easy task to throw myself into - after so much destruction, I relished building something.
She sought me out, not long after we went our separate ways, and assured me neither she nor the orb should pose me any threat in the future.
I know this is a shock, Tara, but please - there's no need to be rude.
You may be mortal, but you look... well, happy. And you wear it rather well.
And you have done an awful lot of good, Wyll. During our time together and every day since then.
We are Warriors of the Comet. We will blaze forth until we burn Vlaakith's bones to ash and smash her phylactery to pieces.
Ramazith's Tower
*The Emperor, once so-named as an insult, now dwarfs his title. He is a god-king-in-waiting, claimant to the stars and all who dwell amongst them.*
Cazador was still out there, after all. But with a little help from some friends, finding and destroying him barely took any effort at all.
The decimation of Gale did not even leave a mark on it.
And proud of it.
You could scream bloody murder out here and no one would ever know.
Your father must be proud of you. Have you been visiting?
Kiss him.
Part of me was relieved you left so quickly after the battle. I felt... ashamed. Like I'd lost everything, just as you claimed your victory. I didn't want you to see me like that.
Smokepowder Barrel Stack
Statue Base
You hunted a scaly devil through the flames of Avernus and got the scars to prove it. They'll believe you.
Leave me. It's over.
Baldur's Mouth Gazette
*No mortal cell could hold you. The bars broke like bones.*
There is much still to do. People to house. A Harper network to rebuild.
Let's not shortchange ourselves, Halsin. How about a kiss?
Have fun tonight, Mr Dekarios. But not too much. There's a good fellow.
*It is an invitation to a celebration for those who stood against the Absolute.*
Provides an image quality virtually indistinguishable from native rendering. Select this if you desire the highest quality.
First, I retrieved the Crown of Karsus, and reforged it using a series of precise and highly-complex Netherese incantations. Then, I used it.
Good - let's just hope the only things that need skewering tonight are the party victuals.
Nature Cleric
Only Mystra herself need know the truth of your accomplishments. And under my guidance, you've served her well.
A githzerai alliance - incredible. Could the gith unite under one sky once again?
*A reprieve from the Blood War, a few hours of respite with the stars above.*
Sorry. It's a reflex when I clap eyes on something distasteful.
Mind-Claw of Tu'narath
Hopefully not during the party.
Gond's true name... I don't know it. I'm afraid I know more of nightingales than gnomes.
Why, are you expecting to be gone for long? All right...
Moonmother's Embrace
Of course. I may be a god, but that doesn't mean I've forgotten my friends.
No, fear not - I've no burning desire to return to this plane. Strange as it is to say, I'm feeling rather at home in Avernus.
Song of Defence: 2
Natural 20 A
Hanging
Researching Bhaalspawn. I want to know everything about Bhaal's taint - just in case.
To be honest, a god's work is mostly bureaucratic.
*A reprieve from the Blood War, a few hours of respite with the stars above, and good company to cheer you.*
And? How's it going?
I've been with Astarion - trying to find a way to cure him.
Ah! Was that-... No. Probably just my mind playing tricks.
I don't know. I rather think tentacles suit me.
Don't be silly. You're adorable when you're nervous. Like a big puppy, anxious where his next petting will come from.
That's what bookmarks are for, Gale. You're allowed to come up for air every now and again.
I'll consider your offer. Thank you.
Come now - out with it! Would be a shame to leave a party like this bereft of music too long.
Using your family name was a show of respect. But you've buried that deep in the litter box, haven't you? Godhood. So vulgar.
Can I look you up, when I'm out?
You are welcome whenever you like and for however long as you please.
1st Place Ribbon Medal
Ultra Quality
Aha! There you are, my mortal friend.
She's kept her leash loose - though I've been no stranger to the Hells.
Party Guest
No - I shall not take you for granted, nor my own past. What is the point of long life, if one does not make room for reflection?
Chk. Don't you dare consider it.
I'm not a fool. I can see through Mizora's lies.
I'll come back to you. I promise.
Well, that makes this evening all the more special. A fond farewell for someone I am most, most fond of.
What say you?
Thank the Abyss that they're as stupid as they are greedy. Throwing those coins was a stroke of sheer genius.
The treacherous dragon-spawn who would steal from our queen.
I've been boring - living a quiet, peaceful life.
Allow code to switch to more dynamic interactions when engaging otherwise primitive crowd characters. This will impact performance.
You've never been far from my mind. Even when lopping off a royal kith'rak's head.
Thank you. Nicest thing anyone's ever said to me.
*The joy in the owlbear's eyes is clear. He longs for a home, and would love to stay with Shadowheart.*
I love you.
I've mostly been focused on establishing my domain. When you're the god of ambition, you can't be seen to do things by halves...
Ahem, and where's my invite?
Read
Just living my life - now I've found someone to live it with.
Until then, I'm right where I'm supposed to be - with the man I love.
Safe to say you've left your fear of wolves in the past, then?
Storm Sorcerer
You know me. I prefer you with your clothes off...
But... I failed her.
I can't join you knowing that Vlaakith still oppresses my people. I'm sorry.
No. This is your battle to fight, not mine.
I am sure that being slain by a heroic blade is of great comfort to your victims.
The hexes and eldritch blasts? Losing them took getting used to. They left behind a cold abyss where fire once raged.
I visited Candlekeep to research Bhaalspawn history. The librarians really fussed over me.
Gith's son has been lost to the shadows. Perhaps one day, when the lich queen is dust, he will step into the light.
And our little hatchling? Is he safe?
Thou art where thou must be - until thou goest where thou must go.
Settlers Bound for Lands Upriver Amid Claims Curse Is Lifted
Just as I have the best interests of Baldur's Gate at heart, so does Mizora.
Let's change subjects.
After everything, I wanted to keep helping people. I've been trying to make a difference.
I have a little cottage now - it's close to my parents and has room for all the animals I've taken in.
I've indulged in the odd spot of magical mischief. Nothing cataclysmic though - I assure you.
Sounds dangerous.
And what might your story prove for a vampire spawn like me? That I too might be able to ascend...
I'm going to enjoy tonight's respite while we can. We'll talk about this later.
I can't believe we triumphed over a pack of goristroi.
Heart C
All right, who's acting the clown?
Nevermind, then. Let's not waste our time on lost causes.
I've been enjoying my innate and effortless talent for magic, of course. No further education required.
Always, my friend. But the villain I must needs slay today is my greatest yet: A deadline!
Your home must smell, um, rustic...
The Hells fear your name - and the Sword Coast hails it. My lover, my legend.
When an enemy dies, turn their corpse into a mildewed, mould-encrusted zombie.
They seem happy, really.
2nd Place Pin Medal
I regret staying, some days. This world is so small... and I already feel my body growing older.
... what the Hells does that mean?
I am glad you have kept yourself occupied. No doubt I will be able to spin a few yarns from the children from this. Thank you.
I'd no idea you thought so highly of me. Especially after you threw that fireball...
In all likelihood, it will be... but we mustn't let that stop us.
Go on, the night's young. You shouldn't waste a moment of it.
Anyway, I have had more than enough to keep me busy while you were off gallivanting in another plane.
The fight continues. Every devil I slay leaves Faerûn a little safer.
Wyll is my home.
You will not live as your queen's reject. Take your own life.
Zhak vo'n'fynh duj. No need to pretend - I know the word means little to you.
For what it's worth, I rather like your new look. It adds a sense of drama - a little more flair.
I've got just the thing.
You do not need to thank me for speaking the truth.
I never thought I'd see the day. But then again, our victory against the Dead Three changed everything.
This world isn't yours for the taking, Astarion. Did the Absolute's rise and fall teach you nothing?
I love you.
Now you mention it, I've always wished to craft a tune so intoxicating that all will adore me - and do nothing else...
Oh, ignore me - I'm perfectly content. Besides, the chance to step out for a night on your arm is hardly one I'm going to pass up.
*Luckily, the illithid powers were but one aspect of your might. You remain in control, now and always. Time to exercise your will.*
Aren't you enjoying seeing everyone again?
*The myconid knows of your transgressions. They must be punished.*
Sketch Bubble Tail A
Online
Pursue your dreams, and keep me in your prayers, and who knows... they might just get answered.

Well, I've had run-ins with my former fellow Sharrans on a couple of occasions. Word seems to have spread of what happened at the Cloister - now other chapters of Shar worshippers see me as a prime target to offer up to their lady as a sacrifice.
And our little hatchling? Is he safe?
You signed an infernal contract, not some half-baked deal on the back of a napkin. If this scheme of yours fails, the Crown of Karsus is Raphael's, whether you 'intended' it or not.
So, if a certain wizard wished to invent a new spell, more powerful than any ever created, you might help with that?
Impressive. She has taught you to deceive yourself so adeptly that perhaps she does not need to direct you at all.
Oh you know, this, that, and the other. The usual godly matters.
You were amazing. When it was over, all that remained was a pair of paltry wings atop a pile of viscera.
I am hunted by my own people. I don't have the luxury of returning to my kin. And you?
That's a lot of animals. Your hands must be cramped from all the petting.
Owlbear Beanie
So am I. Truly.
I smell the clean night air and a faint whiff of ale. Perfect party ambience.
Why is the night air always sweeter? It's such a rich perfume.
Maybe this is what I deserve, for all my sins. A front row seat at the end of the world...

What's the current count again...? Four dogs, eight cats, nine chickens, six pigeons, four sheep, Daphne the milk cow, that odd little squirrel that keeps jumping on my shoulder, and Buttons, of course.
But in time, I realised that darkness is as much a part of me as my fangs. This is only a curse as long as I refuse to embrace the shadows. So I decided I would.
I don't get it.
Tombstone
I have been dwelling far from the public eye. Yet the Emperor and I have grand plans in motion - that I cannot speak of.
Sometimes I could swear that squirrel is looking at me funny...
Summon your mate to protect you in battle.
Wait - what?! That... no! The Absolute must've done this.
Still partial to roaming in bear form, I take it?
Then you did keep count. I should've known you would!
When our adventure began, our troupe had no more in common than the worm in our brains.
Kicking
You could at least try to enjoy it.
Tell me, Lae'zel of K'liir. What reward do you think the Astral Prism will fetch once I pluck it from your corpse and present it to Vlaakith?

Hello petal,

I gave birth to Vanra - or Auntie Vanra, I should say. She fought me the whole way, too, bless her. I told her all about you, and she can't wait to meet her new godparent..

Gosh, they grow up so fast, don't they?.

Alas, I don't have enough for my coven yet, though I have my eye on a darling little blonde in Neverwinter. But Vanra is a good first step.

I think of you every time I look at her.

The Sisters of the Seeing Pearl will be whole once more. And when we are, I look forward to paying you a visit.

After all, you came to my home. It's only fair I return the favour.

Lots of love,

Auntie Ethel
If you're the god of Ambition, what will I become?
Quite a gathering - I hope you've saved a spot for me.
The past made present. I'm glad for it, for this.
Sounds very cosy. I can't wait to warm myself under a blanket with you, next to the fireplace.
Nothing is a sure thing. Try not to get your hopes up, soldier.
Don't get me wrong, I was a mess at first. Every day I yearned for the sun and mourned my curse to live in the shadows.
You asked for this.
I'm sure we can make time to stop by the infirmary - we're on nobody's schedule but our own.
Thank you. I can't tell you how much this means.
Gods, really? Well, if that's what tickles you, I suppose.
Now go on, before I change my mind.
Thanks, soldier. It's good to see you looking so well. And now that we've connected again, don't be a stranger.
I have been fighting across the Astral Sea. Each victory brings us closer to Vlaakith's downfall.
|I've never done anything evil, just to the letter.|
*The joy in the owlbear's eyes is clear - he longs to have a home, and Halsin is perfect.*
Yes. She is not a patron I ever expected to have watching over me... but I am glad for her guidance.
*A pocket of psionic energy reaches out from your mind to Orpheus. Your plea has been heard.*
Can you play a pretty song, reminiscent of taverns and tales?
Mod limit reached!
Promise that once you are done in the Hells, you will return to my side. And help me take Baldur's Gate.
View as List
Do you think the egg is doing well?
Perhaps you might join us. Help us raze it to the ground, put those godly powers to good use.
And it looks like life at Astarion's side is suiting you...
That sounds an awful lot like hard work.
Shar's greatest apostate. Although you seem to be doing rather well without 'the Lady'.
Change Extract
Is this the balance you wished for?
You.
Our victory against the Dead Three changed everything.
Not great, honestly.
To meet again where your journey began, my friend - an honour. For Minsc and his hamster both.
It takes time to heal and rebuild. But if anyone can do it, you can.
Happily putting all of this behind me.
This night offers them a brief respite from me, at least. And this place, now I look at it... it is where you all spent your first night together, no?
Bashful Jaheira
A wise decision. Though, if it's all the same to you, I'd suggest making sure your devotions are of the silent variety.
What about the orb? Did Mystra grant you a cure?
We've taken a more politic approach and seek to ally with the githzerai.
It's good to see you too.
'Biting' time? You make no sense.
Sprouting Necrosis
The matriarch of the Sharran temple herself! I'm honoured, your Lossness.
I understand. I need you, love - but they need you even more.
But I've made contact with an assassin, name of Artemis, a killer of killers. Certain arrangements can be made.
Wolf
You were looking out for him. I expected better of you.
Avernus is... interesting. We've been making a mess down there, that's for sure...
It never crossed my mind to keep track.
The red one's filling them with Bhaal's ire. Make sure he's first to fall.
*Perhaps they can tell you how much time has passed since the last time you were together.*
I'd like to hear how you ended up fighting in the Blood War.
Oh did you now? Come on then - out with it...
*The victory that enabled the war against Vlaakith's tyranny. You cannot be there in person, but you shall be there nonetheless.*
With sharpened edges, this ensemble is not to be worn by the fainthearted... or by those who bleed easily.
Oath of the Ancients Paladin
Black Tie
I've learned much from its monastic orders. Even in the City of Splendours, focus and discipline can be found.
Alters the quality of terrain textures. At higher values, more detail is rendered.
And? How have our friends fared without us?
This world was only the first. You will liberate them all, and raise a new Netheril at last.
Strike an attacker with lightning, dealing [1]. Three more bolts will leap from the target, electrifying as many as three other characters within [2].
Zaerith Menyar-Ag-Gith? What is that?
Now that we can breathe a little, how about a hug?
This Echo of Bhaal is drawing on new, terrible powers to avenge Sarevok's death.
Friends List
I can live with the occasional mistake.
And I you.
I've had six months to make my peace with that. And I really am happy as hell to see you.
|Hug her.|
The Blade of Avernus is on the hunt. The Hells shudder at the very mention of his name.
Phew - probably for the best. I smell like a seventy-year-old cinder.
The city's finally opened its gate to refugees. And it has you to thank.
My only ambition is to serve Lady Shar. A rival god cannot help with that... even one counted as an old friend.

hãy truyền lệnh cho gia bộc nấu sốt vào ngày trước, rồi hâm – luyện lại trong ngày dùng.
Như vậy những vị thổ mộc ấm áp, an ủi sẽ có thời gian hòa quyện.

NGUYÊN LIỆU:
- 2 thìa dầu ô-liu
- 1 phần sườn heo hoặc xương cổ heo nhiều thịt
- 5 tép tỏi, băm
- 1 củ hành tây lớn, xắt hạt lựu
- 1 rổ nấm, thái lát
- 1.5 phần thịt bò xay
- 1 cốc cà chua nghiền hảo hạng
- 4 phần cà chua đóng hộp
- 1 thìa nhỏ đường
- 2 lá nguyệt quế khô
- 1 nhúm lớn oregano khô
- Muối & hạt tiêu, tùy khẩu vị
- Ớt đỏ nghiền, tùy khẩu vị
- 2 nhánh húng quế tươi
- 2 nhánh mùi tây tươi

CHỈ DẪN:
Đốt lò đến nhiệt cao.
Trong lúc ấy, lau khô thịt heo, ướp muối tiêu, rưới dầu.
Đặt vào khay và nướng trong lò tới khi vàng nâu đậm.
Lấy ra để riêng.

Đun nóng phần dầu ô-liu còn lại trong nồi dày đáy.
Phi hành tây và nấm lửa vừa, nêm nhẹ – chớ để cháy sẫm.
Thêm thịt bò xay, đảo tới khi đổi sắc.
Nêm muối, tiêu, oregano.
Thêm tỏi băm, đảo rất nhanh rồi cho cà chua, muối, đường, ớt đỏ nghiền và phần thịt heo còn trên xương.
Thả lá nguyệt quế, húng quế, mùi tây, đưa về sôi liu riu.
Ninh như thế phần lớn một buổi chiều – chừng ba hồi chuông.

Vớt thịt heo ra cho nguội, gỡ thịt khỏi xương, bỏ mỡ và gân sụn.
Xé sợi, trả lại vào sốt.
Nếm điều vị thêm nếu cần.
Khi đã toại ý, làm nguội hẳn và cất vào hàn khố (kho lạnh) qua đêm cho chín mùi.
